name: Loulé
mandate: PrompTugal.news Loulé: AI and technology in Loulé, a council using AI tools and the seat of the Algarve's business association, and what reaches Loulé from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: On the sources read so far, Loulé's weight in AI is institutional more than corporate. The council says it has already contracted AI tools to speed up urban planning, the regional business association NERA is headquartered in the municipality and trains local firms on AI tools, and the Loulé and Faro councils together are tendering a multi-technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that lists AI among its themes. We found no AI company that is clearly headquartered in Loulé besides SPIC, so the map below is short on purpose.

sources.title: Loulé quer mudar paradigma no Urbanismo e acelerar respostas (Barlavento, 28 July 2026)
NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve (home page)
Lançado concurso para instalar centro multitecnológico no Estádio Algarve (Barlavento, 24 September 2026)

look.landmark: The neo-Moorish domes of the Mercado Municipal
look.motif: terracotta, whitewashed chimneys, a market town between the coast and the hills

ai_news.title: Loulé council says it has already bought AI tools for urban planning
ai_news.summary: The president of the municipality told urban planning professionals on 27 July 2026 that the council has already contracted AI tools to support how planning cases are processed, and warned that technology alone will not fix internal bureaucratic obstacles.
ai_news.ai_path: The council itself uses AI tools in its planning process.

ai_news.title: Loulé and Faro tender a technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that lists AI among its themes
ai_news.summary: The Associação de Municípios Loulé/Faro launched a 3 million euro tender in September 2026 for a multi-technology centre for companies and startups at the stadium, half funded under Algarve 2030. Proposals were due on 2 November. The article names AI among the technologies it may host.
ai_news.ai_path: A centre for tech firms jointly run by the Loulé and Faro councils that names AI as one of its themes: the centre, then the AI firms it may host.

ai_news.title: Algarve Evolution opens an AI and robotics call for tourism firms, in a consortium led by Loulé-based NERA
ai_news.summary: Algarve Evolution opened a pilot to pick 15 Algarve tourism SMEs for advice and an action plan on AI and robotics, with applications from 20 February to 30 April 2026. The wider Inova Algarve 3.0 consortium is led by NERA, whose home page gives its municipality as Loulé.
ai_news.ai_path: An AI and robotics programme whose consortium is led by an association based in Loulé.

ai_news.title: A Faro software firm tested its smart irrigation in Loulé, with an AI module planned
ai_news.summary: Visualforma, a Faro company, described a green-spaces irrigation control system developed with Itelmatis and the University of Algarve and tested in Loulé, using field data to optimise watering, with an AI and machine learning module planned. This is older news, from April 2023.
ai_news.ai_path: Loulé was the test site for a smart irrigation system, and its planned AI module is the AI step.

events.title: NERA Lunch & Learn on AI tools for analysis (held 10 November 2026 at CRIA, University of the Algarve, Faro)
events.ai_path: A training session on AI tools, run by the Loulé-based business association.

events.title: NERA online course: AI Social Content Lab (November 2026)
events.ai_path: A training course on using AI for social content, run by NERA.

ai_map.name: SPIC
ai_map.what: Loulé company behind AI.EVENT, a platform in development that uses AI to read audience reactions at events in real time. RTP says it has had European funding.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Loulé
ai_map.what: The municipality says it has contracted AI tools for planning cases.
ai_map.ai_path: It uses AI tools in its own processes.

ai_map.name: NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve
ai_map.what: Regional business association headquartered in Loulé. It leads the Inova Algarve 3.0 consortium and runs AI tool training sessions and courses in November 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: It trains firms on AI tools and leads an AI and robotics programme.

ai_map.name: Algarve AI Agents
ai_map.what: An AI community that BeAlgarve's ecosystem directory lists for Faro and Loulé. We found no page of its own, so its activity is unverified.
ai_map.ai_path: A community dedicated to AI, as listed by the directory.

ai_map.name: Loulé Design Lab (Loulé Criativo)
ai_map.what: Municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI programme found yet.
ai_map.ai_path: A municipal incubator where AI startups could land: the lab, then its startups.

ai_map.name: Ninho de Empresas de Loulé (IEFP)
ai_map.what: Public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI tenants found yet.
ai_map.ai_path: A technology incubator where AI startups could land: the incubator, then its startups.

ai_map.name: Associação de Municípios Loulé/Faro (Estádio Algarve centre)
ai_map.what: Joint body of the two councils tendering a technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that names AI among its themes.
ai_map.ai_path: It is building a tech centre that lists AI among its themes.

gaps: Only one AI company, SPIC, is clearly based in Loulé on what we read, and its article carries no date. A second look at its own site is next.
The council's own news page gave no AI items and no RSS feed. Pages of the council that we could not read yet may hold more.
We could not open Postal do Algarve (a bot check), and Jornal do Algarve and Portugal Resident refused our reads, so some Loulé AI stories may be missing.
Algardata, Shiji Portugal, Lazer Telecom and Innuos are tech firms listed in Loulé by Algarve Tech Hub or older press, but we found no AI link for them, so they are not on the map.
The Algarve AI Agents community has no page we could read. We should look for its own site or a public repository.
Still to look for: the council's LouleXLab (2020), Algarve 2030 AI projects with Loulé partners, UAlg Tec Campus links, and Almancil and Vilamoura tourism-tech firms.

voice.lede: Oi, pá! Loulé, where the market has domes and the council has algorithms.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Loulé: AI and tech from the town with the pretty market, a council that already bought itself some AI, and the Algarve's business association at home. We tell you what reaches Loulé from the Algarve, Portugal and the world, and every fact has a source, pois claro.
voice.gravity: Here AI lives more in offices than in garages, meu. The câmara says it has bought AI tools to untangle planning papers, NERA sits in town teaching firms how to use them, and with Faro the council is tendering a tech centre at the Estádio Algarve that names AI. One real AI company so far, SPIC, so the map is short, and honest about it.
